market_definition: The thermoformed foam parts market comprises parts formed by heating and shaping extruded foam sheets, such as trays, containers and automotive trim. It measures sales of thermoformed polystyrene, polypropylene and PET foam products. BY FOAM MATERIAL: Polystyrene (PS), Polypropylene (PP), PET, Other Foam Sheets. BY PART TYPE: Food Trays & Containers, Protective Packaging, Automotive & Technical Parts, Other Part Types. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Food Service & Food Packaging, Consumer Goods Packaging, Automotive & Transportation, Medical & Pharma Packaging, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Moulded bead-foam parts; extruded foam sheet sold unformed; rigid solid plastic trays; die-cut foam parts. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
